dogecoin.text:
Simple thought: 

#Dogecoin will double before #Bitcoin does.

Do with this info anything you will.

The cypherpunk mailing list were the first beneficiaries of #Bitcoin.

#Dogecoin is available to all who have gotten internet connection.
On the wrong side of history is #dogecoin bears

Money belongs to the masses.

If the masses say $DOGE #dogecoin is money,

Who am I to to not buy some?

For years I have regretted not buying bitcoin at $1

A new window has now been opened with $DOGE.

Thanks to all the #Dogecoin stakeholders

Sorry for all those dudes selling @Dogecoin at this crucial moment.

They won't be remembered in the history books of this decade.

Just as @DogecoinRise
